title: Spicy Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional tacos, filled with marinated chicken and topped with fresh cilantro.
instructions: Marinate the chicken breasts in a mixture of cumin, spicy taco seasoning, and sliced jalapeno peppers for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the chicken breasts for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Shred the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Warm the tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the shredded chicken onto a shell, followed by a sprinkle of cheese, a dollop of sour cream, and a spoonful of salsa.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
